name: Andreas Gruber
bio:
Andreas' motorsport obsession began dismantling and rebuilding his father's moped engine in their small alpine village. This early tinkering led to a degree in mechanical engineering from Graz University of Technology, specializing in advanced materials and computational fluid dynamics. His professional career started at a small Austrian racing outfit before catching the eye of Brad Jones Racing, who recognized his potential and recruited him. 

Andreas is known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving. He believes in data-driven decisions and spends countless hours analyzing telemetry and simulations to optimize car performance. While demanding of his team, he fosters a culture of continuous improvement and relentless pursuit of marginal gains. What sets Andreas apart is his uncanny ability to identify subtle aerodynamic inefficiencies that others often miss, a skill honed by years of studying airflow patterns in the mountains.

physical.description: Andreas is of average height with a wiry build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a precisely calibrated cup of strong black coffee every morning before starting work.
